description.zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries.
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the shared resource.
The ID of the shared resource.

description.zh:
共享单元归属者。

- Self：查询您创建的共享单元中，关联的资源使用者列表。
- OtherAccounts：查询其他账号创建的共享单元中，您作为资源使用者的共享单元及共享单元拥有者列表。
description.en:
The owner of the resource share.

- Self: Queries the principals that are associated with the resource shares you created.

- OtherAccounts: Queries the resource shares that other accounts created and shared with you, and the owners of these resource shares.

description.zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元。
description.en:
The IDs of resource shares.

The value of N can be from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 resource share IDs.

description.zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务](~~450526~~)。
description.en:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the resource types that can be shared, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing](~~450526~~).

descriptions.zh:
如果您是资源所有者，您可以查询您把资源共享给了哪些资源使用者。
如果您是资源使用者，您可以查询您参与了哪些资源共享。

本文将提供一个示例，在`cn-hangzhou`地域，查询您发起的资源共享的资源使用者列表。返回结果显示，您将资源共享给了资源使用者`114240524784****`和`172050525300****`。
descriptions.en:
If you are a resource owner, you can query the principals that you share your resources with. If you are a principal, you can query the resource shares that you are a part of.

This topic provides an example of how to query the list of principals for a resource share that you created in the `cn-hangzhou` region. The response shows that you shared resources with the principals `114240524784****` and `172050525300****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing list-shared-targets --resource-owner Self --resource-type VSwitch --resource-id vsw-bp1upw03qyz8n7us90000 --resource-arn acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000 --max-results 20 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --resource-share-ids rs-6GRmdD3X0000 --targets 1142405247840000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcesharing ListSharedTargets --region cn-hangzhou --Targets.1 1142405247840000 --ResourceArn 'acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000' --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --ResourceShareIds.1 'rs-6GRmdD3X0000' --ResourceId 'vsw-bp1upw03qyz8n7us90000' --ResourceOwner Self --MaxResults 20 --ResourceType VSwitch
